input.quote: 11.3 Effect of Termination. The following Sections shall survive the termination or expiration of this Agreement for any reason: 4.2, 5.3, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12 and 14.
input.rationale: Corio is the licensee/customer under this hosting and license agreement. Reviewing Fees (§4), Term and Termination (§11), Limitation of Liability (§9), Exhibit B Pricing/Revenue Sharing and Exhibit B Payment Terms, there is no liquidated damages provision, penalty, late-payment interest charge, minimum-fee commitment, early-termination fee or acceleration of unpaid fees payable by Corio. Termination under §11.2 simply ends the Agreement (with only ordinary continuing payment obligations for Customers Corio elects to keep supporting under §11.3), and §11.1 termination-for-convenience-on-notice at renewal carries no fee. Amounts flowing the other way (Commerce One's MarketSite transaction revenue share, and refunds of prepaid fees on acceptance-test failure or warranty breach under §3 and §7) benefit us and are compliant with the rule. The revenue share Corio pays to Commerce One under Exhibit B is usage-based consideration, not a liquidated damage or penalty. No redline required; the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties) is already met.
